project.name: dppodex
project.description: A custom implementation of Diffusion Policy Policy Optimization (DPPO) tailored for high-dimensional, state-based dexterous manipulation tasks, targeting the Adroit Hand Pen task with expert demonstrations from Minari.

nodes.summary: Defines neural network architectures for DPPO diffusion policy. Contains SinusoidalPosEmb for encoding diffusion timesteps, DiffusionMLPActor as the noise-predicting policy network that takes state/noisy-action/timestep and predicts noise, and ValueCritic that estimates state values V(s) for GAE computation.
nodes.name: network.py

nodes.summary: Visualization and evaluation utilities for comparing BC (behavior cloning) and DPPO checkpoints. Provides functions to build evaluation environments, load trained actors, run the full reverse diffusion denoising chain, evaluate policies over multiple episodes measuring success rate, generate comparison bar charts, and record rollout videos.
nodes.name: visualize.py

nodes.summary: Gymnasium environment wrappers tailored for diffusion policy optimization. ActionChunkingWrapper executes a chunk of actions sequentially, DiffusionStateNormalizer normalizes observations to [-1,1] via tanh(z-score) using fixed or online statistics, RewardScaler scales rewards for stable PPO advantages, and make_dppo_env composes all wrappers into a ready-to-use training environment.
nodes.name: wrappers.py

nodes.summary: Standard sinusoidal positional embedding module that encodes diffusion timestep k into a dense vector. Uses the classic sin/cos frequency formulation PE(k,2i)=sin(k/10000^(2i/d)), PE(k,2i+1)=cos(k/10000^(2i/d)) to produce embeddings of shape [batch_size, dim].
nodes.name: SinusoidalPosEmb

nodes.summary: The actor network for diffusion policy. Takes state, noisy action chunk, and diffusion timestep k as inputs. Flattens the action chunk, embeds the timestep via SinusoidalPosEmb, concatenates all inputs, and passes through a 4-layer MLP with Mish activations to predict the noise added at step k. Output is reshaped back to [batch_size, chunk_size, act_dim].
nodes.name: DiffusionMLPActor

nodes.summary: Value function critic that maps state observations to a scalar value V(s). Uses a 3-layer MLP with Tanh activations. Used exclusively for computing Generalized Advantage Estimation (GAE) in the DPPO training loop.
nodes.name: ValueCritic

nodes.summary: Constructs an evaluation environment for the AdroitHandPen task. Loads observation normalization statistics from expert_data.pt if available, creates the Gymnasium environment with rgb_array rendering, flattens Dict observation spaces, and wraps with DiffusionStateNormalizer.
nodes.name: build_eval_env

nodes.summary: Executes the full K-to-0 reverse diffusion pass. Starts from pure Gaussian noise, iteratively denoises using the actor network and DDPM scheduler to produce a clean action chunk of shape [chunk_size, act_dim].
nodes.name: run_denoising_chain

nodes.summary: Evaluates a trained actor over multiple episodes, computing success rate. For each episode, repeatedly generates action chunks via reverse diffusion and steps through the environment. Optionally records rendered frames for video generation.
nodes.name: evaluate_actor

nodes.summary: Main comparison function that evaluates both the BC-only and BC+DPPO checkpoints, prints success rate statistics with improvement delta, and generates a matplotlib bar chart saved as bc_vs_dppo.png.
nodes.name: compare_bc_vs_dppo

nodes.summary: Records and saves an MP4 video of the best available policy (DPPO if exists, else BC). Uses imageio to write frames captured during evaluation episodes at 30 FPS.
nodes.name: render_video

nodes.summary: Gymnasium Wrapper that accepts a chunk of Ta actions and executes them sequentially in the base environment. Expands the action space to (Ta, action_dim), accumulates total reward across sub-steps, and preserves success flags once achieved.
nodes.name: ActionChunkingWrapper

nodes.summary: ObservationWrapper that normalizes 1D state observations to [-1,1] using tanh(z-score). Supports two modes: fixed normalization with pre-computed mean/std from expert data, or online Welford estimation when statistics are not provided.
nodes.name: DiffusionStateNormalizer

nodes.summary: RewardWrapper that multiplies rewards by a fixed scale factor (default 0.01) to maintain stable advantage values for PPO updates in dexterous manipulation tasks with sparse or rapidly exploding dense rewards.
nodes.name: RewardScaler

nodes.summary: Instantiates a DiffusionMLPActor with predefined dimensions, loads weights from a checkpoint file, sets the model to eval mode, and returns it.
nodes.name: load_actor

nodes.summary: macOS Finder metadata file (binary, auto-generated).
nodes.name: .DS_Store

nodes.summary: Configuration file specifying patterns for files and directories to exclude from understand-anything analysis. Uses gitignore-style glob syntax. Currently all exclusion patterns are commented out.
nodes.name: .understandignore

nodes.summary: macOS Finder metadata file for the checkpoints directory (binary, auto-generated).
nodes.name: checkpoints/.DS_Store

nodes.summary: PyTorch checkpoint file containing the actor model weights after behavior cloning (BC) pretraining. Serves as the BC-only baseline for comparison with DPPO-fine-tuned policies.
nodes.name: actor_bc.pt

nodes.summary: PyTorch checkpoint file containing the best actor model weights achieved during DPPO fine-tuning, saved when evaluation success rate improves over the previous best.
nodes.name: actor_best.pt

nodes.summary: Downloads the D4RL/pen/expert-v2 human demonstration dataset from Minari, filters successful episodes, constructs sliding-window action chunks of size 4, batch-normalizes observations using mean/std plus tanh squashing to [-1,1], and saves the result as expert_data.pt with keys {states, action_chunks, obs_mean, obs_std}.
nodes.name: download_expert_data.py

nodes.summary: Main function that loads or downloads the Minari D4RL/pen/expert-v2 dataset, iterates through episodes to filter successful ones (checking 'success' or 'goal_achieved' info keys), constructs sliding-window action chunks of CHUNK_SIZE=4, applies batch normalization (mean/std + tanh) to observations, converts to PyTorch tensors, and saves the processed data to expert_data.pt. Falls back to using all episodes if no success info is found.
nodes.name: download_and_convert

nodes.summary: Mathematical utilities for DPPO training. Contains the DashcamBuffer class for storing diffusion micro-step transitions during rollouts, Gaussian log-probability computation for diffusion step transitions, the PPO clipped surrogate objective function, and a helper to extract DDPM log-variance from the scheduler's beta schedule.
nodes.name: dppo_math.py

nodes.summary: Preallocated replay buffer that stores the internal denoising micro-steps from the last K' diffusion steps alongside environment rewards. Stores states, noisy actions, committed noises, k-step indices, log-probabilities, advantages, and returns. The add_trajectory method broadcasts a single-step environment advantage/return across all K' denoising micro-steps. The get_all method returns the full buffer with normalized advantages for PPO updates.
nodes.name: DashcamBuffer

nodes.summary: Computes the Gaussian log-likelihood of a diffusion step transition in noise-prediction space. Uses the formula log P(x) = -0.5 * ((x-mu)^2/var + log(var) + log(2*pi)), where the squared error between predicted and target noise is scaled by the inverse variance, then averaged over chunk_size and act_dim dimensions to produce a per-batch scalar log probability.
nodes.name: calculate_gaussian_log_prob

nodes.summary: Implements the standard PPO clipped surrogate objective. Computes the probability ratio exp(new_log_probs - old_log_probs), creates both unclipped and clipped (epsilon=0.2) surrogate objectives, and returns the negative of the minimum as the loss to maximize the policy improvement lower bound.
nodes.name: compute_ppo_objective

nodes.summary: Extracts the log-variance log(beta_k) from the DDPM scheduler's beta noise schedule for given diffusion steps k_steps. Returns shape [batch, 1, 1] for broadcasting over chunk_size and act_dim dimensions. Uses the DDPM posterior variance approximation sigma_k^2 = beta_k.
nodes.name: get_ddpm_log_variance

nodes.summary: Jupyter notebook (designed for Google Colab) that orchestrates the full DPPO training pipeline. Cell 1 mounts Google Drive, copies project files, and installs dependencies (diffusers, gymnasium, gymnasium-robotics, mujoco, minari). Cell 2 defines a main() function that: loads expert normalization stats, creates the Adroit pen environment with wrappers, initializes actor/critic networks and DDPM scheduler, runs BC pretraining (50 epochs, skipped if actor_bc.pt exists), optionally resumes from DPPO checkpoints, then runs DPPO fine-tuning for 500 iterations with periodic evaluation and checkpointing.
nodes.name: main.ipynb

nodes.summary: Project documentation for the DPPO dexterous manipulation implementation. Covers the architecture (AdroitHandPen-v1 environment, 45-dim observations, 24-DoF actions, action chunking with Tp=4), the five-component project structure (expert data download, environment wrappers, neural network backbones, DPPO math/buffer, training loops), training order (download data, BC pretraining, DPPO fine-tuning, visualization), output file descriptions, and references to the original DPPO paper and Adroit demonstrations.
nodes.name: README.md

nodes.summary: Main training module containing three core functions for the DPPO pipeline: behavior cloning pretraining (supervised denoising on expert data), deterministic policy evaluation (K-step denoising rollout to measure success rate), and DPPO fine-tuning (environment rollouts with frozen old policy, advantage estimation via critic bootstrapping, and PPO updates on the last K' denoising steps). Imports mathematical utilities from dppo_math.py.
nodes.name: train.py

nodes.summary: Supervised pretraining loop that trains the diffusion actor to predict noise added to expert demonstrations. For each batch: samples random diffusion timesteps k, corrupts expert action chunks with Gaussian noise via scheduler.add_noise(), forward-passes the noisy actions through the actor, and minimizes MSE loss between predicted and actual noise. Uses AdamW optimizer with lr=1e-4. Logs loss every 10 epochs.
nodes.name: train_behavior_cloning

nodes.summary: Runs deterministic evaluation episodes with no exploration noise. For each episode: starts from pure noise and runs the full K-step reverse denoising chain using the actor's mean noise prediction, executes the denoised action in the environment, and tracks success via the info dict's 'success' key. Returns the fraction of successful episodes out of num_episodes.
nodes.name: evaluate_policy

nodes.summary: Core DPPO reinforcement learning loop running 500 iterations. Each iteration: (1) Rollout phase -- collects num_env_steps transitions using the frozen old_actor, runs full K-step denoising with stochastic committed noise sampling (mean + sigma*z), records the last K' micro-steps in the DashcamBuffer with bootstrapped advantage A_t = r_t + gamma*V(s') - V(s). (2) PPO update phase -- runs 2 epochs over the buffer, updates critic via MSE on returns, updates active_actor via the clipped PPO objective computed on Gaussian log-probs in noise-prediction space, with gradient clipping at 0.5. Syncs old_actor weights after each iteration. Saves checkpoints every 50 iterations, evaluates every 20 iterations, and saves actor_best.pt when success rate improves.
nodes.name: train_dppo

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with the README to understand the full scope of this DPPO implementation. The project targets the AdroitHandPen-v1 environment, where a 24-DoF Shadow Hand must reorient a pen. Key architectural decisions are documented here: action chunking (Tp=4 prediction horizon, Ta=2 execution horizon), DDPM-based diffusion with RL fine-tuning on only the last K'=3 denoising steps, and a two-phase training pipeline (behavior cloning from Minari expert data, then PPO fine-tuning). Pay attention to the training order and output files sections, which map the end-to-end workflow.

tour.title: Expert Data Pipeline
tour.description: Before any training can happen, expert demonstrations must be prepared. This script downloads the D4RL/pen/expert-v2 dataset from Minari (4,958 episodes of human pen manipulation), filters to only successful episodes (~4,130), and converts them into sliding-window action chunks of size Tp=4. Observations are batch-normalized using mean/std followed by tanh squashing to map states into [-1, 1]. The output expert_data.pt bundles states, action_chunks, and the normalization statistics (obs_mean, obs_std) that will be reused later during environment rollouts to prevent distribution shift between BC pretraining and RL fine-tuning.

tour.title: Environment Wrappers
tour.description: The raw AdroitHandPen-v1 environment expects single-step actions, but a diffusion policy produces action chunks. This file defines three Gymnasium wrappers that bridge the gap. ActionChunkingWrapper accepts a [Ta, action_dim] chunk and executes each sub-action sequentially, accumulating rewards and preserving success flags. DiffusionStateNormalizer applies the same fixed mean/std + tanh normalization used during data preparation, ensuring the policy sees identically distributed observations at both training phases. RewardScaler multiplies rewards by 0.1 to keep PPO advantage magnitudes stable. The factory function make_dppo_env composes all wrappers in the correct order.

tour.title: Neural Network Architecture
tour.description: This file defines the two neural networks at the heart of the system. SinusoidalPosEmb encodes the diffusion timestep k into a high-dimensional vector using the classic sin/cos positional encoding formula (PE(k,2i)=sin(k/10000^{2i/d})), giving the actor awareness of which denoising step it is performing. DiffusionMLPActor concatenates the encoded timestep with the flat state vector and the flattened noisy action chunk, then passes them through a 4-layer MLP with Mish activations to predict the noise that was added -- this is the epsilon-prediction formulation standard in DDPM. ValueCritic is a simpler 3-layer MLP with Tanh activations that maps a state to a scalar value V(s), used for advantage estimation during PPO. Note that the critic has no diffusion-step conditioning since it only needs to evaluate environment states.

tour.title: DPPO Mathematical Foundations
tour.description: This file contains the mathematical machinery that makes diffusion-aware PPO work. DashcamBuffer is a preallocated buffer that stores T x K' micro-step transitions -- for each physical environment step, it records the noisy action input (x_k), the committed noise (sampled epsilon), the diffusion step index, and log-probabilities for all K' fine-tuned denoising steps. A single environment-level advantage A_t = r_t + gamma*V(s') - V(s) is broadcast identically to all K' micro-steps belonging to that environment step. calculate_gaussian_log_prob computes log-likelihoods in noise-prediction space using the DDPM posterior variance (log beta_k) extracted by get_ddpm_log_variance. compute_ppo_objective implements the standard clipped surrogate loss with epsilon=0.2, operating on the ratio of new-to-old noise log-probabilities rather than traditional action log-probabilities.

tour.title: Training Pipeline
tour.description: This file implements both training phases. train_behavior_cloning performs supervised pretraining: for each batch, it samples random diffusion steps k, corrupts expert action chunks with Gaussian noise via the DDPM scheduler's add_noise, and trains the actor to predict the added noise using MSE loss. evaluate_policy runs deterministic denoising (full K-to-0 chain without stochastic sampling) and reports success rate. train_dppo is the RL fine-tuning loop running 500 iterations. Each iteration has two phases: (1) Rollout -- the frozen old_actor performs K-to-0 denoising with stochastic committed-noise sampling, storing only the last K'=3 steps in the DashcamBuffer alongside bootstrapped advantages; (2) PPO Update -- the active_actor recomputes noise predictions and log-probabilities for the buffered micro-steps, computes the clipped surrogate loss, and updates with gradient clipping at 0.5. The old actor is synced after each iteration. Checkpoints are saved every 50 iterations, with the best model tracked by evaluation success rate.

tour.title: Evaluation and Visualization
tour.description: The final step closes the loop by evaluating trained policies and producing visual results. compare_bc_vs_dppo loads both the BC-only checkpoint (actor_bc.pt) and the DPPO-fine-tuned checkpoint (actor_best.pt), runs each over multiple evaluation episodes, and generates a side-by-side bar chart (bc_vs_dppo.png) showing the success rate improvement from RL fine-tuning. render_video records an mp4 of the best available policy performing the pen reorientation task. This file also demonstrates the imports from network.py (DiffusionMLPActor) and wrappers.py (DiffusionStateNormalizer), showing how the evaluation pipeline reuses the same normalization and architecture modules to ensure consistency with training. The entry point main.ipynb orchestrates the full pipeline from data download through training to evaluation.
